## EdgeSlider 1.5.1
- The options hidden in 1.5 are back under a collapsed "Advanced" section in the menu bar panel: Edge Width, Hold Delay, Bottom Quarter Only, Corner Position, Show Percentage, Freeze Cursor and automatic update checks. The main view stays simple.

## EdgeSlider 1.5
- Simpler menu bar panel: one page with Sensitivity, Haptic Feedback, Swap Sides, Quick Mute, Switch Output and Open at Login. The separate Settings page is gone. - Only one copy of EdgeSlider can run at a time. Opening it again no longer starts a second one.

## EdgeSlider 1.4
- New: Corner Position. Choose whether the corner double-taps (Quick Mute and Switch Output) use the top or the bottom corners of the trackpad. Find it under Settings. - New: Hold Delay. The edge sliders now wait a moment (150 ms, adjustable in Settings) before engaging, so a palm brushing the edge no longer changes brightness or volume. - Removed: the media strip (bottom-edge swipe to skip tracks).
